title: I finally shipped my AI-assisted game. Uzeran is now line on the App Store
author: kutan74
selftext:
After months of prototyping, throwing away ideas, rebuilding systems and constantly questioning whether the game was actually fun, I finally shipped Uzeran, my mobile endless runner.

It was built in Unity, and AI was a big part of my workflow. Here is how I used AI:  
\- Coding assistance and debugging  
\- Rapidly iterating on gameplay ideas  
\- Getting a second opinion on game design decisions  
\- Turning rough ideas into implementations much faster

Probably the biggest lesson for me was that AI makes iteration dramatically faster, but it doesn't solve the hardest question in game development: is this actually fun? 

Uzeran eventually became a fast precision endless runner focused on weaving through obstacles, near misses and maintaining your combo at high speed.

Would love to hear what you think. 

App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/uzeran/id6793195642](https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/uzeran/id6793195642)
